name: ppt-count
description: PowerPoint add-in that counts words and characters in the selected text, shapes, tables and groups.
author: Joe Zandstra <joezandstra@gmail.com>

scripts.sideload: office-addin-debugging start manifest.xml desktop --app powerpoint --no-debug --dev-server "node scripts/serve.mjs" --dev-server-port 3100
scripts.start: npm run certs && npm run sideload
